module: Braking component of the drivingDynamics system (type "auxiliary", defaultOrder 70). It acts as traction control (order 30), yaw control (order 50) and ABS (order 50) by braking individual wheels. The traction and yaw braking is added every step to wheel.desiredBrakingTorque in updateWheelsIntermediate; the ABS replaces each wheel's brake torque computation functions (wheels.setWheelBrakeUpdate). Each role is handled by parallel PID regulators configurable in the jbeam or via setParameters.
notes: Top-level jbeam keys: useForTractionControl, useForYawControl, useForABSControl (booleans, true by default); tractionControl (table, required to enable the TC role) with wheelGroupSettings (header table: motorName, slipThreshold (0.2), slipRangeThreshold (0), maxVelocity (1, m/s), kP/kI/kD (0), integralInCoef (20), integralOutCoef (2)); yawControl (table, required to enable the YC role) with PIDSettings (header table: type = yawAV|slipAngle|frontAxleSlipAngle, kP, kI, kD, integralInCoef, integralOutCoef), yawAVThreshold (0.4), slipAngleThreshold (0.1), frontAxleSlipAngleThreshold (0.2); absControl.wheelSettings (header table: wheelName, absFrequency (100 Hz), slipThreshold (0.2), kP (5), kI (0.5), kD (0.1), integralInCoef (20), integralOutCoef (20), minSteeringCoef (0.3), steeringCoefYawRate (0.2)).

Potential bug: initSecondStage reads jbeamData.absControl.wheelSettings as soon as the absControl supervisor exists and useForABSControl is true, without checking that jbeamData.absControl is defined (Lua error if absent).

Yaw control: three PIDs (yaw error, body slip angle, combined front/rear slip angle); the strongest picks the wheel to brake: oversteer -> outer front wheel, understeer -> inner rear wheel; the factor is reduced at low wheel speed (anti-lock, 2..5 rad/s).

Traction control: one PID per wheel on the slip, weighted by the speed (zeroed above maxVelocity+1 m/s) and by the group's slip range; the final brake factor per wheel is min(TC + YC, 1) * wheel.brakeTorque, applied with max().

ABS: every absTime period (1/absFrequency) a PID computes a braking coefficient absCoef based on the slip, reduced at high yaw (steeringCoef); without speed > 2 m/s the ABS is inactive (absCoef = 1). The left/right/center torque limits (absBrakeTorqueLimits) prevent a wheel from braking much harder than the opposite wheel.
electrics.values.isYCBrakeActive, isTCBrakeActive, isABSBrakeActive (0/1) are written every frame; isABSBrakeActive is always 0 ("TODO fix whatever this is" comment in the code).

setParameters accepts many keys: tractionControl.isEnabled, tractionControl.wheelGroupSettings.<motor>.(slipThreshold|slipRangeThreshold|maxVelocity), tractionControl.wheelBrakingPID.<wheel>.(kP|kI|kD|integralInCoef|integralOutCoef), yawControl.(isEnabled|slipAngleThreshold|yawAvThreshold|frontAxleSlipAngleThreshold), absControl.wheelSettings.<wheel>.(kP|kI|kD|integralInCoef|integralOutCoef|slipThreshold|absFrequency|minSteeringCoef|steeringCoefYawRate). The yaw PID parameters (PIDSettings) are read but not modifiable via setParameters (they are only applied by setConfig).

isActingAsTC.desc: True when a traction control brake is active.

isActingAsYC.desc: True when a yaw control brake is active.

isActingAsABS.desc: True when the ABS limits the braking.

init.desc: Resets the action flags to false.

initSecondStage.desc: Reads the configuration, creates the PIDs and registers with tractionControl, yawControl and absControl depending on their presence; installs the ABS brake functions on the wheels.

reset.desc: Resets flags and PIDs and reinstalls the ABS brake functions.

updateWheelsIntermediate.desc: Every step: adds the TC/YC brake of each controlled wheel to wheel.desiredBrakingTorque and rotates the ABS torque limits.

updateGFX.desc: Writes electrics.values.isYCBrakeActive/isTCBrakeActive/isABSBrakeActive then resets them to zero (debug version: also sends a detailed packet).

actAsTractionControl.desc: Called by tractionControl for each wheel group: computes each wheel's braking factor from its slip.

returns.desc: True if a traction control brake is requested.

actAsYawControl.desc: Called by yawControl: picks the wheel to brake according to the dominant PID (yaw error, body slip angle, front slip) and sets its brake factor.

returns.desc: True if a wheel is braked by the yaw control.

actAsABSControl.desc: Called by the absControl supervisor for each wheel: periodically updates the ABS coefficient (absCoef) via a PID on the slip.

returns.desc: True if the ABS reduces braking (absCoef < 0.9).

registerCMU.desc: Stores the reference to the CMU.

setParameters.desc: Applies parameters (see notes) then reconfigures the PIDs.

setConfig.desc: Replaces the entire configuration and reconfigures the PIDs.

getConfig.desc: Returns a copy of the configuration.

sendConfigData.desc: Sends the configuration to the CMU.
